Find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best!

Depending on the order is the system's performance.
Each symbol can only be present once in the output sequence.

Here are the four symbols with their performance properties:
A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceded by symbols A and/or C
C = yields best performance unless it is the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol

The optimal order for the given symbols would be D-B-A-C. This arrangement ensures that each symbol is used only once and placed in a position where it can yield its best performance. Starting with D as the first symbol maximizes its potential, followed by B which should not be preceded by A or C. Next is A, which performs well when not followed by more than one symbol, so placing it second to last ensures this condition is met. Finally, C should be the last symbol unless it negatively affects the overall system performance.
